subject.title: feat(browser): send pages to OpenClaw from the Chrome extension

question: Should popup and shortcut page sharing fail closed for a focused child-frame selection until that selection can be captured, rather than sending the enclosing top-level page?
rationale: This is a user-data disclosure boundary, not a routine implementation detail: accepting full-page fallback changes the product’s explicit-share and selection-first promise.

options.title: Require selection-safe fallback
options.body: Reject the share when a focused child frame may own the selection, or capture that frame’s selection, before allowing merge.

options.title: Accept full-page fallback
options.body: Document that popup and shortcut can share surrounding page content for child-frame selections and explicitly accept that privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Require selection-safe fallback
recommendation.body: Reject the share when a focused child frame may own the selection, or capture that frame’s selection, before allowing merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor directly to the browser page-share design and the stated child-frame tradeoff.
